exposure: Gestational age at elective repeat cesarean delivery (<39 weeks vs >=39 weeks)
outcome: Neonatal adverse outcomes (pulmonary complications, hyperbilirubinemia, APGAR score <7 at 5 minutes, NICU admission)
cohort: 1461 singleton pregnant women scheduled for repeat cesarean section at term from the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Prapokklao Hospital
finding: There were no significant differences in neonatal outcomes between elective repeat cesarean deliveries performed at <39 weeks and >=39 weeks gestation.
birth_weight: Reported, but specific values not provided
